name: Tika Panggabean
bio: Kartika Rachel Setia Redjeki Panggabean (born October 3, 1970) is an Indonesian singer, actress, comedian, and presenter. She is one-sixth of the comedy vocal group, Project Pop. She is known for Missing Home (2022), Ali & the Queens (2021), and the TV series OB (Office Boy).

credits.title: A Bowl of Chicken Noodles Before I Die
credits.overview: If today were your last day, what one small thing would you really want to do?  For Ale, the answer is simple: enjoy a bowl of his favorite chicken noodles before he truly gives up on life. But when his regular food cart is closed, that situation leads him into a series of unexpected encounters.

credits.title: Agak Laen: Menyala Pantiku!
credits.overview: After repeatedly failing their missions, Detectives Bene, Boris, Jegel, and Oki are given one last chance: to go undercover in a nursing home in search of a fugitive wanted for the murder of the mayor’s child.

credits.title: Until The Last of You
credits.overview: When his long-time secret crush is diagnosed with ovarian cancer, a devoted man stands resolutely by her side through worsening illness and chooses to marry her, proving that true love can endure the ultimate test.

credits.title: Missing Home
credits.overview: A married couple stages their divorce in order to encourage their estranged adult children to return to their hometown.

credits.title: Selesai
credits.overview: Ayu wants to leave her partner, Broto, because she is tired of being cheated on. However, the pandemic lockdown comes, and her mother-in-law arrives at their home. In the midst of Ayu's efforts to protect her mother-in-law's feelings, Broto discovers a new fact about his wife that has never been revealed before.

credits.title: Ali & Ratu Ratu Queens
credits.overview: After his father's passing, a teenager sets out for New York in search of his estranged mother and soon finds love and connection in unexpected places.

credits.title: Glorious Days
credits.overview: Because of an incident when they were in high school, members of the Bebas Gang were forced to separate. 23 years later, one of them is seriously ill and hopes to meet again one last time.

credits.overview: A celebrity policeman, always followed by cameras due to his reality show, is paired with a conman to arrest a drug kingpin who escaped from prison.

credits.title: Sweet 20
credits.overview: Adapted from Korean movie, Miss Granny, this movie tells a story of old woman that despise old-age that suddenly transform to a pretty girl with all her youth problems.

credits.overview: A divorced couple, Bagas and Risa, wish to remarry. But to lawfully do so, they must first find a "contract husband" to briefly marry and divorce Risa.

credits.title: The Proposal

Detectives issue her an undercover boyfriend, Aan, in order to protect her. Although this doesn’t sit well with her family, their relationship progresses to more than just a cover.

credits.overview: As a young group of friends navigates the pitfalls of love, Deon tries to court the newly single Fira using the ta'aruf process.

credits.title: Langit Biru
credits.overview: Three first year junior high school teenagers lives closely in a housing complex since childhood.

credits.title: Red Cobex
credits.overview: A group of mothers rise up to clean up their town, but their fight begins to tear the community apart.

credits.overview: A mismatched group of misfits become guerrillas as Indonesia attempts to maintain its independence when colonists return in 1948.
